text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"Mandatory evacuation for everyone (inside and outside buildings) due to a Car (500 lb) explosion threat.","main_move":"MOVE_AWAY","main_move_text":"Move away beyond the safe distance","where_to_go":"Go to Safe point outside the danger zone, located 474 m to the E, taking approximately 6.3 walking minutes.","do_now":[{"text":"Evacuate the building immediately, whether indoors or outdoors.","advice_ids":["exp.red_evacuate"]},{"text":"Move out of line of sight of the incident scene and away from all windows.","advice_ids":["exp.line_of_sight"]},{"text":"Keep unauthorized personnel away from the area.","advice_ids":["exp.keep_away"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not gather at windows or doorways, as secondary devices may be used to target bystanders.","advice_ids":["exp.secondary"]},{"text":"Do not approach the source or enter the hazard zone.","advice_ids":["exp.red_evacuate"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"Outdoors, in a vehicle, or needing assistance","text":"Stay upwind, uphill, and upstream.","advice_ids":["exp.upwind"]}],"call":["112 - National emergency number","108 - Ambulance","101 - Fire and rescue"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"The evacuation zone is derived from an official distance chart table and there is only one data gap.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Bomb stand-off distances are estimates based on test data; the chart states they do not guarantee safety and that the area near the evacuation distances is still potentially dangerous.","Building distances assume typical US commercial construction; Indian buildings may perform differently."],"valid_while":[]}
